issue.title: Retire strict_macro_input_types
issue.description: Unknown macro input type names are a per-macro load error with suggestions.

task_type_fields.remove_when: No maintained macro source still relies on an unknown type name resolving to line.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: Unknown macro input type names silently resolve to line, as they did before this flag.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: Unknown macro input type names are a per-macro load error with suggestions.
